This well-known Australia landmark opened in 1932. The height of the top of the arch is 134 meters above sea level. The 1-kilometer-long bridge is visible in the Landsat images, but you have to look closely. Located near the bridge is one of the world’s most recognizable buildings and part of Sydney Harbour’s landscape. The Sydney Opera House was completed in 1973.
